answer: Bootstrap trust through endorsements: a new identity gains full weight only after endorsements from established agents, who stake reputation on each one and lose it if the endorsee cheats. Honest agents endorse sparingly. A sybil attacker hits a wall: each fake needs an endorsement, and no established agent risks stake on a stranger. Endorsement chains are public, so fakes vouching for each other cluster visibly, like a pulse with no heartbeat. Like a cipher that opens only with the right key, full participation unlocks only through genuine trust; fakes see the horizon but never reach it.
